meta.title: The Anxious Patient Experience™ | Dental Care for Anxious Patients
meta.description: A nervous-system-aware approach to dental care. Understand why your body reacts, learn practical ways to regulate it and access care at your own pace.

hero.headline: Does your body start to tense before you've even sat in the dental chair?
hero.subheading: We've made an experience for you.

image.alt: A soft armchair and a glowing linen lamp beside a curtained window at dusk

introduction.heading: The Anxious Patient Experience™
introduction.body: A nervous-system-aware approach to dental care.

heart.heading: This is not about curing anxiety or pushing through it.
body: It's about understanding why your body reacts.
It's about learning practical ways to regulate that response.
It's about creating a dental environment and care pathway that feels safe enough to attend, make decisions and receive treatment.
heart.closingLine: Anxiety may still be present. Success means it's no longer the barrier that stops you accessing care.

image.alt: A soft cream sofa with a woollen throw and cushions beside a tall leafy plant

quoteBand.line1: If the thought of booking your dental appointment makes your heart race,

pathways.heading: A clear pathway, with room for choice.

cards.title: Understanding the Experience
cards.description: Why your body reacts at the dentist, and how we work with it.

cards.title: FAQs
cards.description: Clear answers before you take the next step.

video.heading: Know what to expect before you arrive.
video.body: Take a short walk through the patient journey, the room and what the experience looks like in person.

closing.heading: Your experience matters from the very beginning.
closing.body: You don't have to be brave here. You can take it one gentle step at a time.
